exxhd6:294: The biggest risk of agent autonomy is runaway spending. When a single agent issues multiple parallel payments (flights, hotels, car rentals) at once, read-write races on a shared budget cause overspending. AgentCore Payments builds a three-phase atomic protocol into the payment session layer: first, atomically reserve the requested amount from the available budget; second, execute the actual payment through the provider; third, commit the settlement on success, or roll back and restore the reserved amount on failure. This ensures that under high concurrency, no matter how many agents transact simultaneously, there are no stale reads, write overwrites, or overspending. Developers get deterministic budget execution guarantees without building any custom concurrency or locking logic.
